name: Tomb Mason
description: This unfinished stone worker still tries to repair the dungeon around living intruders. Its chisel-like fist knocks defensive stances apart.

abilities.description: Starts combat with 3 block. Absorbed damage spends it permanently for this fight.
Destroys up to 2 player block before striking.
